phase: Pre-primary plan, algebra, core/checkpoint/CLI and runner implementation review complete; root final numerical gates pending.
decision: Accept one component-wise bounded gain with a lower-triangular two-pass square-root array update for the frozen small falsification, subject to implementation and numerical/fault gates. No performance promotion or lifetime/coverage/target claim.

plan_consistency.status_thresholds: Plan explicitly retains predecessor local status thresholds and semantics; source equality to be checked when implementation is ready.
plan_consistency.scope: One chosen-gain change with the factor representation/diagnostics/checkpoint changes necessary to implement it. No prior, noise, process-noise, forgetting or local-status retuning.
plan_consistency.publication: Predecessor source versions remain in baseline git history and the bounded_online_001 provenance bundle. Frozen predecessor results are not edited.

representation.coordinates: Static 11 first: log tau1..3, log gamma+/-, log Q, R0, R1..3, H; current z, v1..3, h last.
representation.factor: P=L*L^T with L lower triangular, exactly zero numeric entries above the diagonal, nonnegative diagonal, and zero/rank-deficient pivots admitted. Store in the existing full 256-double array.
representation.initial: Same public means and support-width-derived diagonal Gaussian scales as 001; no posterior imported from the predecessor or truth.
representation.prediction: The sparse physical Jacobian F is lower triangular in this ordering. F*L is lower triangular, with nonnegative diagonal because dynamic diagonal entries are positive exponential attenuation or one. Finite/domain validation remains mandatory.

algebra.definitions: P=L*L^T, h=voltage gradient, sigma>0, w=L^T*h, s=sigma^2+w^T*w, sd=sqrt(s), innovation=e.
algebra.first_pass: Descending right orthogonal rotations j=15..0 eliminate top-row w_j and yield B=[[sd,0],[g,Lopt]]. Since B*B^T=A*A^T, g=P*h/sd and Lopt*Lopt^T=P-g*g^T.
algebra.component_gain: Set standard=e/sd. Independently choose lambda_i in [0,1] from each coordinate admissible mean movement, with the inherited 1-1e-9 backoff only when constrained. Set t_i=lambda_i*g_i. Compute mean_i_new=mean_i+t_i*standard from this same t_i; no separate final mean clipping.
algebra.actual_gain: K=t/sd, so the mean update is K*e.
algebra.sum_of_squares: With d=g-t, Joseph Pnew=Lopt*Lopt^T+d*d^T. There is no covariance subtraction or downdate in the implemented factor construction.
algebra.second_pass: Ascending right rotations j=0..15 compress [Lopt,d] to [Lnew,0]. Orthogonality gives Lnew*Lnew^T=Lopt*Lopt^T+d*d^T, the full Joseph covariance for the actual chosen component gain.
algebra.old_formula: The predecessor common-scalar rank-one factor formula is not used. A component-dependent gain cannot be substituted into that scalar coefficient.
algebra.scope: Real-arithmetic chosen-gain identity; floating-point agreement is a separate finite numerical gate.

shape_and_rank.descending_invariant: Before column j, the carried state noise column g is zero above row j+1; lower column j is zero above row j. Rotating only rows i>=j preserves all previous upper zeros. After rotation the noise column is supported only from row j downward. Its row-j entry was zero, so the new L_jj=c*old_L_jj remains nonnegative.
shape_and_rank.descending_rotation: a starts sigma. r=hypot(a,w_j), c=a/r, q=w_j/r. For i>=j, using both old values, (g_i,L_ij) becomes (c*g_i+q*L_ij, c*L_ij-q*g_i). Set a=r. The eliminated top-row value is conceptual; each original w_j is read once. Current implementation evaluates identity rotations when w_j=0, remaining within the fixed 16-rotation bound.
shape_and_rank.ascending_invariant: Before column j, d_i=0 for i<j and L_ij=0 for i<j. Rotation of column j with d cannot alter those zeros. Set L_jj=hypot(L_jj,d_j)>=0 and d_j=0; rotate only rows i>j.
shape_and_rank.singular_safe: First-pass norm is at least sigma>0. The second pass skips identity when d_j=0, including a zero/zero pivot, and otherwise divides only by hypot(L_jj,d_j)>0. No inverse, bare-diagonal division, rank threshold or variance floor is required.
shape_and_rank.rank_increase_witness: For P=[[1,1],[1,1]], h=(1,0), sigma=1 and t=(0,1/sqrt(2)), the rank-one prior becomes Pnew=[[1,0.5],[0.5,0.5]], which has rank two. The blocked coordinate variance stays one; feasible-coordinate learning and changed correlations are retained. Embed this example in 16 dimensions for a decisive singular test.
shape_and_rank.legacy_state: Version-1 nontriangular factors are incompatible. Version-2 checkpoint identity and lower-factor validation must reject them explicitly; no silent upper-entry discard or posterior conversion.

transaction_and_noop.prediction: Validate input before mutation. Stage and validate physical prediction and the known-input ledger, then commit that prediction to live state.
transaction_and_noop.correction: Mutate only the existing workspace.candidate during both factor passes, mean limiting and diagnostics. Commit corrected candidate only after finite/domain/triangular/metadata and post-correction observation checks succeed.
transaction_and_noop.failure: Any correction-stage failure preserves the committed physical prediction and chronology, adds one rejected-voltage count/flag, and discards the prospective correction. Negative invalid-input returns remain atomic; known propagation-loss recovery keeps its declared separate behavior.
transaction_and_noop.all_gain_zero: If every actual t_i is zero, copy the retained predicted mean/factor bytes and skip mean writes. Orthogonal round-trip covariance equality is not enough for exact bytewise retention.
transaction_and_noop.zero_innovation: An exactly zero innovation with nonzero selected gain still changes covariance and advances evidence. Do not confuse no mean displacement with no information.
transaction_and_noop.storage: Prediction and prospective correction occupy the existing live state and candidate state; no third state or full factor is required.

diagnostics.min_max: last_gain_scale and last_max_gain_scale are the minimum/maximum lambda over active g_i!=0, both one when none. A zero minimum does not imply total stall.
diagnostics.masks: limited_mask identifies active lambda_i<1. blocked_mask identifies active actual t_i==0, including numerical disappearance of a limited component.
diagnostics.counts: limited_gain_count counts nonempty limited masks. zero_gain_count counts all-zero actual t, including zero sensitivity. Thus zero_gain_count may exceed limited_gain_count; the predecessor inequality must be removed, while each count remains bounded by voltage_count.
diagnostics.evidence: Advance the evidence position and availability only if some t_i is nonzero. A no-sensitivity observation does not manufacture availability. Operational counters survive cold reset; post-reset rates subtract the reset counters.
diagnostics.cold_reset: Reset belief-epoch minimum gain, last scales/masks and availability consistently with the new public prior; preserve cumulative operational counters.

necessary_tests: Independent dense Joseph versus Lnew*Lnew^T for correlated lower factors, partial zero/interior/full component gains, mixed signs/scales and all-free Kalman equivalence.
Independent dense prediction covariance and physical/voltage finite differences only where needed for changed representation; verify sparse F preserves exact upper zeros.
The explicit partial-gain rank-increase witness, singular/zero pivots, zero sensitivity, zero innovation, and exact all-zero-gain mean/factor retention.
A nuisance coordinate at an outward boundary while SOC/Q remain feasible; verify the final mean and covariance use the same t, including the backoff and near-bound rounding.
A correction fault after physical prediction commit, including failure in either rotation pass or final validation: retain prediction/ledger and reject only the voltage.
Version-2 complete checkpoint and fresh-process continuation, new masks/scales/counters, nontriangular/legacy-version rejection and unchanged cold-reset ownership.
No-sensitivity diagnostics where zero_gain_count exceeds limited_gain_count, zero gain with previously retained evidence, and overflow guards for every cumulative counter.

fixed_work_forecast.other: Fixed state copies, sparse physical prediction, mean-domain checks and factor/metadata validation remain O(16 squared). Zero-elimination rotations may skip; no history-sized loop, QR of a dense general array, optimizer or adaptive inner iteration.
fixed_work_forecast.scope: Source-level operation structure, not measured Cortex-M23 instruction count, worst-case time, energy or deadline proof.

storage_forecast_bytes.delta_from_001: The 16 B of additional diagnostics occur in state, candidate and query, adding 48 B to core/host named storage. The serialized state adds 16 B.
storage_forecast_bytes.reuse: Existing four 16-double vectors hold h, w, g and d; prospective means are staged directly in candidate. Existing persistence buffer reuse remains available.
storage_forecast_bytes.scope: Forecast before compilation; final sizeof, linker placement, own-source stack, library/runtime/acquisition/interrupt/persistence staging and target costs require the separate final memory account. Serialized checkpoint bytes are not a second whole-file RAM buffer.
storage_forecast_bytes.owner_measurement_status: Forecast agrees with checkpoint/driver owner reported measurements: 5896 B core, 7064 B named host, 2456 B checkpoint. Full stack/runtime accounting remains separate.

limitations: Gain limiting depends on the observed innovation. The Joseph identity holds for the chosen gain, but does not prove exact Bayesian constrained covariance, truncated support or calibrated coverage.

Orthogonal factor arithmetic avoids subtracting covariance matrices but still has finite rounding, cancellation and underflow risks. Validate finite rotations and outputs; use old pair values for both updates. No lifetime stability or availability theorem follows.
Local Gaussian bias and wrong narrow capacity beliefs remain independent blockers. Cell A cold failed capacity with little post-reset stall in 001; fewer zero gains alone is not success.
No process noise, variance floor, uncertainty inflation, prior/status retuning or hidden evidence reuse is introduced.
One frozen 35-minute two-cell harness is a finite falsification. Annual endurance, measured-cell coverage, temperature/aging behavior and full Cortex-M23 qualification remain open.

implementation_review.status: accepted for the frozen small falsification; no concrete source blocker found, subject to root final numerical/fault gates
findings: Descending first and ascending second rotations use saved old pairs and preserve lower shape. Positive sigma and hypot pivots avoid inverse/rank assumptions.

The exact selected t is used for both staged mean movement and d=g-t. Independent coordinate limiting keeps feasible updates when another coordinate is blocked; no scalar formula or mean-only final clip remains.

The valid predicted state is committed before correct() touches candidate. Every correction failure returns to the caller which retains that prediction and records only rejected voltage; final observation and full state validation precede correction commit.

All-zero selected gain restores predicted mean/factor bytes; zero residual with nonzero gain still learns covariance. No-sensitivity diagnostics are unit min/max, zero masks, increased zero_gain_count and no manufactured evidence.
Upper-zero/nonnegative-diagonal factor validation is explicit. Removed obsolete zero_gain_count<=limited_gain_count; blocked-mask subset limited-mask is sound for active nonzero g.

Source diff retains prior means/scales, physical equations, supports, noise and local status thresholds. Only new diagnostics/public-reset values, factor/gain/transaction logic and representation validation change.

Version-2 codec encodes last maximum gain and both masks in 16 additional payload bytes; header magic/model/version and fixed 2456 B record distinguish the new lower-factor semantics. Restore reads and validates the bounded header before size/payload and never mutates the destination before complete integrity/configuration/state validation.

Checkpoint tests include a complete reconstructed version-1 record with matching old CRC and a version-2 nonlower factor with valid CRC, so semantic rejection is exercised independently of corruption detection. Existing workspace candidate and 128 B stdio vector are reused.

CLI identifies model 2 and the componentwise feasible Joseph algorithm, emits new masks/extrema, and reports fixed named storage and 2456 B persistence. Its observation-only inputs, source/delivery handling and lifecycle schedule remain inherited.

Separate 002 runner preserves the original runner. It verifies plan/input/model identities and clean source before inference, refuses existing output directories, snapshots/hashes the binary, runs the same 12-process control/warm/cold schedule and performs no truth access or batch optimization.

Runner compares complete query state/resources and checkpoint hashes for warm parity, records cold availability reset, checks cumulative rejected-voltage counters and recovery flags, and verifies source/binary/data identities after execution. JSON receipts are atomically replaced; raw first-process output remains streamed and preserved.
implementation_review.tests_inspected: The dense oracle explicitly forms P, independently chosen K, (I-KH)P(I-KH)^T+K R K^T and compares the output covariance and mean.
